entities.summary: Roberto Robaina was a political leaders in Pinar del Río (b. 1956-03-18, Pinar del Río) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
